import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-pp9pdzg5/bench_opencode_torch-tensor-parallelism_e0mand6r")
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    W = torch.randn(8, 12); x = torch.randn(3, 12, requires_grad=True)
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
        m = cls(12, 8, True, W.clone())
        ref = torch.nn.Linear(12, 8); 
        with torch.no_grad(): ref.weight.copy_(W); ref.bias.zero_()
        xi = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(); xr = x.detach().clone().requires_grad_()
        y = m(xi); yr = ref(xr)
        assert torch.allclose(y, yr, atol=1e-5)
        (y**2).sum().backward(); (yr**2).sum().backward()
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            c = 8//ws; sl = slice(rank*c, (rank+1)*c)
            assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad[sl], atol=1e-4)
            assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, ref.bias.grad[sl], atol=1e-4)
        else:
            c = 12//ws; sl = slice(rank*c, (rank+1)*c)
            assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad[:, sl], atol=1e-4)
            assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, ref.bias.grad, atol=1e-4)
        assert torch.allclose(xi.grad, xr.grad, atol=1e-4)
    if rank==0: print("ok", ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=="__main__":
    for i, ws in enumerate((1,2,4)):
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws, 29600+i), nprocs=ws)
EOF
